prompt:

Asset type: new full-body work-angle and dance key-pose atlas for a layered desktop companion.
Reference: ONLY the FIRST woman from the left (LEAD): short chestnut bob with a pale front streak, green eyes, white cropped work jacket over dark teal blouse, charcoal high waist wide trousers and black-white sneakers. Adult woman aged about 25. Preserve her exact recognisable face, adult anatomy, hairstyle, accessories, clothes, palette and shoes.
Exactly eight drawings, arranged as FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of equal cells. No other characters. Keep each FULL BODY entirely within its cell, with at least 8% transparent padding on EVERY edge, including raised hands, toes and hair. Same anatomical scale in all cells; 6.5-head-tall adult proportions. Match the reference's fine crisp pixel-art black outlines and rounded shading.
TOP ROW left to right: (1) three-quarter toward left, actively working with a small dark tablet and stylus; (2) left SIDE PROFILE doing the same work, with a clearly different drawn torso/face perspective; (3) REAR THREE-QUARTER, same work with prop in front, looking over shoulder, genuinely drawn back of the clothing; (4) seated sideways on a simple low dark stool, working with a small dark tablet and stylus, complete visible legs and feet.
BOTTOM ROW left to right: four genuinely different balanced key poses for light confident two-step: ready stance with relaxed knees and arms out; left side step with one palm high, right hip counter-turn; opposite side step pointing playfully; knee lift with hands on opposite diagonals. Dance WITHOUT the handheld work prop. Distinct arm, elbow, hip, knee and foot placements; do not make tilted copies. Hair/coat follow the motion naturally.
Transparent RGBA canvas, actual transparent pixels. No background, glow, ground shadow, coloured edge halo, checkerboard, grid, labels, writing, border or effects. Preserve exact outfit across all eight cells. Anatomical hands with five fingers. Each drawing will become independent head, torso, arm and leg layers for animation.
